★Request
Costume specification: Tanino Gimlet (Uniform: Summer) displayed
No props

■Stage Direction
"Übermensch" = Nietzsche's concept of the "Overman". A resilient entity capable of actively affirming life and finding joy even within it (German).
Tanino Gimlet's original mocktail recipe.
Wondering where that scent came from, I opened my eyes—

Bathe in your moratorium a while longer.
...I will prepare your awakening glass whenever you desire.

Then a momentary flash is what befits you.
...Is that not so, neighbor?

Indeed, you chose to raise your goblet to me.
Therefore, you are bound by duty to be intoxicated by me.

Walk those stages, and in time,
you shall attain my spirit.
A mocktail had been poured into the glass before me.
—Drink. It is the "Übermensch".
And the intoxication of a Gimlet is something that beckons the fleeting moment.

Magnificent!!! Awaken from winter's slumber
and sing praise to spring!!! Savor life to the absolute fullest!!!!

God is dead. The hour has arrived to bid farewell to myth.
In other words, I have begun to walk the present... but what of you?
...Heh. So foolish a question it leaves you speechless?

...A crisp, lively sound blended into my foggy consciousness.
At the same time, a fresh citrus aroma brushed past my nose.

Very well.
In deference to your will, I shall set down signposts.
I thought I understood, yet I didn't—

...Apparently, I had fallen asleep.
And right in front of me, for some reason, was Tanino Gimlet.

And to be completely honest...
Even now, as her dedicated Trainer, I still didn't really understand.

How the spirit undergoes the three stages, how
the lion transforms into a child. I never spoke of it to you.

...Heh, naturally. Just as you are duty-bound to be intoxicated,
I am duty-bound to intoxicate.
Surely you do not intend to indulge in postponement forever?
(*Shaka, shaka, shaka*)

Leaving those words behind, Tanino Gimlet departed.
What on earth did she mean by "signposts"...?
No matter. You need not force words from your lips.

Having just woken up, I had no idea what was going on...
Or why she was even here in the first place—

Ever since the day we met,
Tanino Gimlet's words and actions were eccentric and arcane.
...No, as expected, I don't get it.
...Yo. Has your moratorium ended?

And then—bursting through the crisp, refreshing flavor
came a lively tartness that instantly cleared my mind...!
Drawn in as if pulled toward the cool liquid surface, I took a sip.

Regardless, now that I was her dedicated Trainer,
I knew I needed to learn more about her.
A dubious look. Are my actions that bewildering to you?

Ahhahahahahaha!! Just like Venus gracing this mortal coil!!
A radiant countenance!! A visage overflowing with the joy of life!!!!
